card.name: Pipe that opens a table
card.fires_on: The vertical bar character (|) that starts a table, right after a sentence that introduces or ends a passage. It is strongest after phrases like 'the table below shows'.

modes.label: Table introduced
modes.description: A pipe begins a table straight after a sentence announcing it.
modes.example: The table below shows the Moon position compared to the time and date above: <<|>>Time||Longitude difference||Latitude difference||

modes.label: Pipe after finished text
modes.description: A pipe starts a new block of table-like page text after a normal sentence.
modes.example: you should certainly ask for advice from your pediatrician. <<|>> Read more

card.plain: It marks the bar symbol that opens a table or a new boxed section after ordinary text.
